title: Set evidence storage and verification operating bounds
objective: Record a measured topology ADR with unresolved cost facts, a fixture-only operating-bounds policy, and a standalone evidence-receipt contract without activating collection or editing connectors.
outcome: Proposed ADR 0008 leaves cheapest topology null. Policy activation remains false. Evidence receipts distinguish capture, 304, access-only, pre-egress, typed failure, truncation, and the unmatched Census historical HTML negative. Descriptor hash_basis is ushso-canonical-json.v1. PR-008 has no integration merge SHA.
